# DY Electrical Services

> Licensed electrical contractor serving Logan, Brisbane Southside and the Northern Gold Coast (QLD, Australia). Services cover residential, commercial and emergency electrical work. Electrical Contractor No. 87141 · ARC Licence L179309 · ABN 75 643 388 416.
